The context window of the provider's models: automatic, or the number of tokens the
user set (a local engine's depends on its machine).

Has the local engine download a model, if the administrator allows it; follow it
with `/pulls/{pull_id}`.

schema.title: Response List Workspaces Api Workspaces Get

post.description: An article written by hand, without a brief: in the Library at once, as a draft.
« Dupliquer »: a new article, without a brief, from a copy of the version given.

« Envoyer en Bibliothèque », then « Valider » a later version: the version given is the
one exports and publications take.

delete.description:
Removes the copy « Modifier » made of a model's version when the editor is closed
without a change. 409 for any version saved since, or written by the model.

put.description:
« Enregistrer » a version retouched in the editor: a person's version is updated, a
version of the model is kept and the person's version is added. With `as_new`, a new
version is added whatever the version edited. 409 when the version changed since the
editor loaded it.

get.description:
A version as a file (X03c): pdf, docx, html, md (a ZIP when it has images), txt or json,
with its Sources block and AI mention. Made on demand, never stored.
The same for every workspace in phase 1; each workspace edits its own in phase 2.
The briefs of the workspace, the most recently changed first.

schema.title: Response List Briefs Api Workspaces  Workspace Id  Briefs Get

post.description: Creates a brief; its items move to drafting in the triage of its author.

delete.description:
Empties the details and attempts of the drafts of the brief (diagnostics only: the
versions themselves stay).

get.description: The article written from the brief, with its versions, and the latest generation.

post.description:
Asks the worker for a draft of the brief, a new version of its article; while one
runs, the same is answered. Sources too thin: 409 `insufficient_matter`, unless the
author confirms (« Générer quand même »).

delete.description: Cancels the draft being written for the brief: no version is made from it.

get.description: The texts of the brief's sources, for the reference panel of « Comparer ».

schema.title: Response Brief Sources Api Workspaces  Workspace Id  Briefs  Brief Id  Sources Get

get.description:
The feed of the user: pinned items first (except for `all`), then in the order of
`sort`; `before` (the id of the last item of the previous page) pages back.
`topic_id`, repeated, keeps the items of at least one of these topics, or of all of
them with `all_topics`; `since` and `until` keep the items dated in between;
`group_by` with `group` keeps one group of `/feed/groups` (no `group`: the items
without topic, or the manual entries).

schema.title: Response Get Feed Api Workspaces  Workspace Id  Feed Get

get.description:
The groups of the feed, by main topic or by source, with the same filters as
`/feed`, and how many items each holds; the group without key comes last.

schema.title: Response Feed Groups Api Workspaces  Workspace Id  Feed Groups Get

get.description:
« Tout sélectionner »: the ids of every item the feed shows with these filters, over
all its pages and groups (5000 at most).

schema.title: Response Feed Ids Api Workspaces  Workspace Id  Feed Ids Get

get.description:
The latest items, newest first, without their full text; `before` (the id of the
last item of the previous page) pages back.

schema.title: Response List Items Api Workspaces  Workspace Id  Items Get

delete.description:
Removes an item from the watch of the whole workspace, with its text. An item of a
feed leaves its address behind, so that the collection does not bring it back.
Withdraws the declaration: the text read under it is erased; the record stays.

get.description: Whether rights may be declared on the item, and the declaration in force.

post.description:
« J'ai les droits sur ce texte » (Joël, 2026-10-20): the declaration is kept and the
page read under it, within robots.txt and the limits of the site.

Reads the page of an item again when its text was missed for a technical reason;
409 `not_retryable` for a refusal of the site (robots.txt, a reservation of mining).

get.description: The topics of an item, with their explained scores, and the same story elsewhere.

schema.title: Response List Media Api Workspaces  Workspace Id  Media Get

post.description:
Imports an image into the workspace: decoded, re-encoded without its metadata (GPS
position, camera, author), no larger than 4096 pixels a side. 413 above 15 MB; 422 when
it is not a JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF image. `name`: the file's; `bank`: imported into the
bank of images of the médiathèque.
Adds the images chosen to the bank of images, or takes them out of it.

Deletes the images chosen that no article shows, in any version; the others are
refused (in_use).
The files Otlet stores of the images chosen, in one ZIP, unchanged.

get.description: The tags of the images of the workspace, in order.

get.description: An image, and the articles that show it, with their versions.
The file Otlet stores of an image, unchanged, to save: « Télécharger l'original ».

put.description: Tags an image (40 characters, 20 tags at most: 422 invalid_tags).

get.description: The small image the médiathèque shows, never the original.
How far the user went in the first steps: sources, topics, first decisions.
